content.text: The action has two linked issues: it returns early when the requested state matches the computed feature state, so an override can’t be removed while the base plan still enables the feature; and the service condition exempts plan-based flags even when `overridable` is false. I’m fixing the state check to inspect stored overrides and making feature evaluation ignore overrides unless the definition permits them.
